events.summary_en: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado announced on Sunday that she has returned to her homeland following almost a year in exile, after covertly leaving Venezuela in late 2025 to receive the Nobel Peace Prize. She returns as doubts about her country’s democratic future and the role of the US are growing. Venezuela’s opposition leader and Nobel Peace Prize winner Maria Corina Machado returned home after more than 10 months. Machado had left the country just a month before the US government seized Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro.
